name: Afflictions
overview: Scripture teaches that afflictions are a consequence of the fall, as seen in God's pronouncement to Adam and Eve that sorrow, toil, and hardship would mark human life (Genesis 3:16-19). These afflictions are part of the human condition, with God sovereignly appointing and regulating their measure and duration. Though often severe and arising even from the profession of the gospel, afflictions are never beyond what we deserve and ultimately serve God's purpose, frequently terminating in good and demonstrating His love and faithfulness, as illustrated in the promise to Abram that affliction would precede deliverance and blessing (Genesis 15:13-14).
